Accountant I Job at Fountain University




        
    

        
        Fountain University is a Private University Licensed in May 2007 by the Federal Government and commenced academic activities in January 2008. The Vision of the University is to be a pace-setting institution in terms of learning, character- building, entrepreneurial skills, and service to humanity. Its Mission is to produce competent and resourceful graduates with high moral standards; and the Philosophy is the total development of men and women in an enabling environment through appropriate teaching, research and service to humanity, as underlined by Islamic Ethics and Culture.

Applications are hereby invited from suitably qualified candidatess for the vacant position below:

 Job Position:  Accountant I
     

            
    



Job Location: Osogbo, Osun
Department / Unit: Bursary

Requirements


	Candidates should possess a B.Sc. Degree in Accounting (2nd Class Lower), + ICAN/ANAN


Other Requirements:


	NYSC Discharge / Exemption Certificate, Computer literacy, and proficiency in ICT relevant to the job
	Evidence of professional registration where applicable.


Salary Grade
FUNTISS 8.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates are to submit their Applications, CV, and supporting documents in a single PDF to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

The Detailed and Signed Curriculum Vitae should contain the following:


	Full Name (Surname in Capital Letters)
	Position Applied For
	Date & Place of Birth
	State of Origin
	Nationality
	Marital Status
	Contact Address
	Phone Number
	Email Address
	Educational Qualifications with Dates
	Professional Qualifications
	Work Experience
	Present Employment & Salary
	Publications
	Membership of Professional Bodies, Awards
	Extra-Curricular Activities
	Name of Next of Kin
	Names and Addresses of 3 Referees (one of whom must be in the Candidate's field).


Note


	Candidates should request their nominated referees to forward their reports directly to the Registrar via: [email protected] or [email protected]
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Head of Sales Job at Jobtion Consulting




        
    

        
        Jobtion Consulting is a premier human capital and workforce solutions firm helping organizations attract, develop, engage and retain talent while empowering individuals to build meaningful, sustainable careers. We operate seamlessly at the intersection of talent, strategy and opportunity, providing highly practical and customised solutions across advisory,  recruitment, and learning solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head of Sales
Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time, Onsite
Reports to: CEO/MD

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Jobtion Consulting is supporting a fast-growing organisation in the food and beverage distribution sector to recruit an experienced Head of Sales.
	This is a strategic commercial leadership role for an ambitious commercial builder who can translate business ambitions into revenue growth, stronger distribution, market penetration and profitable commercial performance.
	The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO/MD and Commercial Director, leading the sales function across channels and territories while building the strategy, systems, team and commercial discipline required to scale the business.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute the company's sales and commercial growth strategy.
	Own sales volume, revenue, distribution and market penetration targets.
	Develop growth plans across territories, channels, products, customers and distributors.
	Build a data-driven sales function using commercial dashboards, KPIs and performance insights.
	Lead, coach and develop a high-performing sales team.
	Drive route-to-market and distribution expansion across priority channels.
	Build and strengthen distributor, key account and customer relationships.
	Partner with Finance and leadership on revenue, margin, cash flow and commercial profitability.
	Establish robust sales forecasting, planning and performance management systems.
	Provide market intelligence and actionable commercial recommendations to senior leadership.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
	8–12+ years of progressive sales/commercial experience.
	At least 5 years in a senior sales or commercial leadership role.
	MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
	Strong FMCG, beverage, wine, spirits, food distribution or related sector experience.
	Proven experience managing multi-territory sales operations.
	Demonstrable track record of growing revenue, market share and distribution.
	Experience working with distributors, wholesalers, key accounts, modern trade and/or on-trade channels.
	Strong commercial intelligence, analytical ability and leadership capability.


Salary
N1,000,000 – N1,500,000 gross monthly.

	Ability to work independently and take initiative.
	Strong networking and relationship-building skills.

	Must be target-driven, organized, and results-oriented.

Sales & Business Development Executive Job at Castville Solutions




        
    

        
        Castville Solutions is a recruitment and business solutions provider specializing in the healthcare sector. We focus on connecting healthcare facilities with highly skilled professionals, enabling efficient operations, and driving business growth. Our services extend to recruitment, Templates for process and operations management, SOP development, and healthcare-specific training, with a clear mission to transform the healthcare workforce and operations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales & Business Development Executive
Job Location: Lekki-Ekpe Express Way, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a proactive and results-driven Sales/Business Development Executive to drive sales and business growth for our furniture company.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, attracting customers, building strong client relationships, and developing strategies to increase revenue and market presence.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue new sales opportunities and generate leads through networking, referrals, social media, cold calling, and other channels.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with individual customers, corporate clients, interior designers, real estate companies, hotels, and other potential business partners.
	Follow up on leads, enquiries, quotations, and prospective customers to convert opportunities into sales and meet agreed targets.
	Develop and secure bulk, corporate, customized, and partnership opportunities that can increase the company’s revenue.
	Conduct market research to identify customer needs, competitors, pricing trends, and new opportunities for business growth.
	Provide regular sales reports and market feedback to management while working closely with Production and Operations to ensure smooth delivery of customer orders.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree / HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
	2–4 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role.
	Experience in furniture, interior design, real estate, construction, retail, or a related industry is an advantage.
	Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
	Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
	Good understanding of sales and customer relationship management.
	Ability to work independently and take initiative.
	Strong networking and relationship-building skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM/sales tools.
	Must be target-driven, organized, and results-oriented.
